text:
Sophia: Hey team — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4872
Sophia: Summary: small routing fallback + KV cache TTL tweak. Touches auth header ordering in the proxy path. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before canary. Planning canary Tue 10:00 PST (2-step rollout).
Ben: looking now
Charlie: can do infra review, but I need the exact canary slot reserved in calendar. I'm OOO briefly at 9-9:30 PST.
Tess: security: I noticed auth header ordering change in the diff. Did you run the authz integration smoke tests? Also any change to header canonicalization needs a unit assertion.
Sophia: I added unit tests and a smoke job in the PR CI, links in the PR. Smoke passed on staging once, failing once due to a flaky downstream mock. Logs attached in the PR comments.
Sophia: Rollout plan in PR description: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate >= 1% or latency 2x baseline. Will monitor deploy dashboard.
Liam: I'll own the canary dashboard and alerting. Ping me 15m before canary and I'll set the dashboard to 5m refresh.
Ben: runtime: quick perf pass queued against staging (batching and KV exercise). ETA ~45m. If that passes, runtime can +1.
Tess: small ask: please add an explicit assertion for header canonicalization in the unit tests (one liner). I can re-review quickly after that.
Sophia: adding that test now and pushing — will comment when pushed :rocket:
devops-bot: Canary slot reserved: Tue 10:00 PST for PR #4872 (requested by Sophia)
Charlie: noted on infra side. If runtime gives green, infra is +1 for the canary.
Ben: runtime perf job finished: latency targets met on N=3 runs (gtx-4090 pool) at typical concurrency. Saw a small p95 bump under heavy concurrency but within SLO margin. Posting perf summary in PR.
Sophia: thanks Ben — tagging @Ben @Charlie @Tess for final approvals. I'm keeping the rollout conservative.
Tess: review comments addressed, added the one-line test, and verified the authz path locally. Approving now.
Charlie: infra approved — no infra config changes required.
Ben: runtime approving after perf green.
Sophia: awesome — merging during Tue 10:00 canary window, will post a short runbook + rollback steps in the thread before the window. Thanks everyone :tada:
